description_html: Position Overview   We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile  Senior ATM & Financial Systems Software Engineer  to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level embedded hardware systems and modern cloud-native enterprise architectures. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and securing critical ATM software, transaction processing systems, and administrative dashboards. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of financial protocols, robust security standards, and modern DevOps practices, ensuring high availability, compliance, and seamless integration across our distributed banking infrastructure.     Key Responsibilities     ATM Software Development:  Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance software for ATMs and financial self-service terminals, ensuring seamless low-level interaction with hardware components.   API & Integration Engineering:  Architect, implement, and maintain secure internal and external APIs for ATM fleet management, real-time status reporting, and seamless integration with core banking and enterprise systems.   Security & Cryptography Implementation:  Implement and enforce advanced security measures, including cryptographic protocols (Triple DES, AES), tokenization, secure boot processes, and intrusion detection systems to safeguard financial transactions and terminal integrity.   Full-Stack & Dashboard Development:  Build scalable backend services using modern languages and develop intuitive, responsive administrative dashboards for fleet monitoring and system configuration.   Database & Telemetry Management:  Design and optimize relational databases for transactional integrity and leverage NoSQL databases for high-volume logging, auditing, and telemetry data analysis.   DevOps & Cloud Deployment:  Orchestrate containerized deployments and manage backend infrastructure on cloud platforms, utilizing automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid, reliable, and secure software delivery.   Compliance & Regulatory Adherence:  Ensure all software development and system configurations strictly adhere to financial regulations, industry standards (e.g., EMV, ADA), PCI DSS, and internal corporate compliance policies.   System Diagnostics & Troubleshooting:  Diagnose, debug, and resolve complex software and network issues within a highly critical, distributed, and high-availability production environment.   Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner closely with hardware engineers, cybersecurity specialists, compliance officers, and business stakeholders to align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.      Qualifications: Experience     Minimum Experience:  5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on embedded systems, financial transaction systems, or ATM software development.   Embedded & Low-Level Systems:  Proven track record of developing low-level applications interacting directly with hardware peripherals (e.g., card readers, cash dispensers, encrypting PIN pads).   Full-Stack Development:  Demonstrated experience building enterprise-grade backend services and modern, responsive web-based administrative dashboards.   Financial Transaction Systems:  Hands-on experience working with financial transaction messaging standards and secure payment processing workflows.   Security Hardening:  Direct experience hardening operating systems (Windows Embedded/Linux) and implementing secure coding practices, threat modeling, and vulnerability remediation.   Cloud & Containerization:  Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud environments using container orchestration platforms.      Technical Skills     Programming Languages:    Low-Level/Systems:  C++, Java   Backend/Services:  Python, Node.js, Go   Frontend Frameworks:  Angular, React, Vue.js     Database Management:    Relational:  PostgreSQL, Oracle Database   NoSQL:  MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar (for logging and telemetry)     Operating Systems:  Windows Embedded, Linux Distributions (Red Hat, Ubuntu, etc.), including OS-level security configurations and hardening.   Networking & Financial Protocols:    Network:  TCP/IP, HTTP/S, SFTP, TLS/SSL   Financial:  ISO 8583 (transaction messaging), EMV (chip card standards)     Security & Cryptography:    Encryption Standards:  Triple DES, AES, RSA   Security Mechanisms:  Tokenization, Secure Boot, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Threat Modeling, Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST)     Cloud & DevOps:    Cloud Platforms:  OSE (OpenShift Container Platform)   Containerization:  Docker, Kubernetes   CI/CD Tools:  Jenkins, Tekton, Git/Bitbucket, and automated testing frameworks        Professional Skills     Analytical & Problem-Solving:  Exceptional diagnostic and analytical skills, with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex, distributed, and highly critical systems under tight timelines.   Communication & Collaboration:  Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.   Regulatory & Compliance Mindset:  Deep commitment to security, quality, and compliance, with a meticulous approach to adhering to industry standards and regulatory mandates.   Adaptability & Continuous Learning:  Ability to rapidly adapt to evolving technologies, bridging the gap between legacy embedded systems and modern cloud-native architectures.      Education & Certifications     Education:   Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.                    ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $125,760.00 - $188,640.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.    We are building the next generation of memory design by embedding AI into how circuits are designed, validated, and brought to silicon. We work at the intersection of design, CAD, and data, and we focus on solutions that scale across teams and technology nodes. If you want your work to directly impact silicon outcomes, this team delivers!    This role is critical to transforming memory design workflows using AI and automation. You will partner closely with design, layout, CAD, and product teams to reduce manual effort, improve quality, and accelerate time-to-tapeout across memory products.     Responsibilities:   Embed AI and automation into PDN analysis, power integrity validation, and optimization workflows  Apply data-driven methods to predict IR drop, voltage droop, current density, decoupling effectiveness, and electromigration risk during early design stages  Enable AI-assisted optimization of power grid architectures, bump planning, package-PDN co-design, and decap placement  Leverage historical design, simulation, and silicon data to drive predictive power integrity insights and design recommendations  Develop machine learning and generative AI solutions to automate root-cause analysis and accelerate PDN design-space exploration  Collaborate across power integrity, design, CAD, package, and product engineering teams to scale AI-enabled methodologies and workflows     Minimum Qualifications:   Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience  5 to 7 years of experience in power integrity, PDN design, circuit design, physical design, package design, or EDA workflows  Strong coding skills with the ability to develop and maintain production-quality software in Python or similar languages  Experience applying data analysis, machine learning, or automation to engineering workflows  Understanding of power delivery networks, IR drop analysis, voltage integrity, or related semiconductor design domains     Preferred Qualifications:   Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field  Experience applying AI or ML to power integrity, physical design, package design, simulation, or silicon data analysis  Knowledge of memory subsystem power delivery, package-PDN interactions, and full-chip power integrity methodologies  Experience with EDA tools and flows for power integrity analysis and optimization  Familiarity with machine learning techniques such as graph neural networks, surrogate modeling, large language models, or agentic AI systems  Experience collaborating across design, CAD, package, process integration, test, or product engineering teams       The US base salary range that Micron Technology estimates it could pay for this full-time position is:    $170,000.00 - $290,000.00 a year   Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses and equity.
